cards.card_text: Then Elihu talks about people crying out under great oppression, pleading for relief from the arm of the mighty.
cards.verse_text: Men cry out under great oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the mighty.
cards.snippet: Men cry out under great oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the mighty.

cards.card_text: He also asks, “Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?” His enemies taunt him like the crushing of his bones, all day long, with that same question: “Where is your God?”
cards.verse_text: Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?” Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
cards.snippet: Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?” Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they…

cards.card_text: He also asks a question straight out of Psalm 42: “Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
cards.verse_text: Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
cards.snippet: Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?

cards.card_text: He asks why God forgets their affliction and oppression.
cards.verse_text: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
cards.snippet: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?

cards.card_text: Nope, malice and trouble lie within, destruction is within, and oppression and deceit never leave the streets.
cards.verse_text: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.
cards.snippet: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.

cards.card_text: The prayer says the king will redeem the oppressed from oppression and violence.
cards.verse_text: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
cards.snippet: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.

cards.card_text: Then the psalm speaks of a hard time: when they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil and sorrow.
cards.verse_text: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
cards.snippet: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,

cards.card_text: The psalmist asks the LORD to redeem him from the oppression of man, so that he may ___ the LORD's precepts.
cards.verse_text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
cards.snippet: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.

cards.card_text: Then the Teacher looks again, and this time he considers all the oppression taking place under the sun.
cards.verse_text: Again I looked, and I considered all the oppression taking place under the sun.
cards.snippet: Again I looked, and I considered all the oppression taking place under the sun.

cards.card_text: They rejected this message, and they're trusting in oppression and relying on deceit.
cards.verse_text: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: “Because you have rejected this message, trusting in oppression and relying on deceit,
cards.snippet: …One of Israel says: “Because you have rejected this message, trusting in oppression and relying on deceit,

cards.card_text: By oppression and judgment He was taken away, cut off from the land of the living.
cards.verse_text: By oppression and judgment He was taken away, and who can recount His descendants?
cards.snippet: By oppression and judgment He was taken away, and who can recount His descendants?

cards.card_text: In righteousness she will be established, far from oppression.
cards.verse_text: In righteousness you will be established, far from oppression, for you will have no fear.
cards.snippet: In righteousness you will be established, far from oppression, for you will have no fear.

cards.card_text: Then they name it: rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from their God, and speaking oppression and revolt.
cards.verse_text: rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering lies from the heart.
cards.snippet: rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering lies from the heart.

cards.card_text: There is nothing but oppression in her midst.
cards.verse_text: This city must be punished; there is nothing but oppression in her midst.
cards.snippet: This city must be punished; there is nothing but oppression in her midst.

cards.card_text: Dishonest gain, shedding innocent blood, extortion and oppression, that's the whole list.
cards.verse_text: “But your eyes and heart are set on nothing except your own dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood, on practicing extortion and oppression.” Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: “They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my brother!
cards.snippet: …your own dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood, on practicing extortion and oppression.” Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah…

cards.card_text: Cease your violence and oppression…"
cards.verse_text: Cease your violence and oppression, and do what is just and right.
cards.snippet: Cease your violence and oppression, and do what is just and right.

cards.card_text: Instead of violence and oppression, what does God tell the princes of Israel to do?
cards.verse_text: Cease your violence and oppression, and do what is just and right.
cards.snippet: Cease your violence and oppression, and do what is just and right.

cards.card_text: And they will begin to diminish under the oppression of the king of princes.
cards.verse_text: Though they hire allies among the nations, I will now round them up, and they will begin to diminish under the oppression of the king of princes.
cards.snippet: …now round them up, and they will begin to diminish under the oppression of the king of princes.

cards.card_text: The great unrest and acts of oppression The new walls going up around it The great feast being held there
cards.verse_text: Proclaim to the citadels of Ashdod and to the citadels of Egypt: “Assemble on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest in the city and the acts of oppression in her midst.”
cards.snippet: …Samaria; see the great unrest in the city and the acts of oppression in her midst.”

cards.card_text: The Lord has seen His people's oppression in Egypt, and He's sending Moses back, like the job you ran out on calling forty years later to say start MONDAY.
cards.verse_text: I have indeed seen the oppression of My people in Egypt.
cards.snippet: I have indeed seen the oppression of My people in Egypt.
